description.narrative: The proposed investment consists of a first tranche of US$50 million anchor investment in a 5 year unsecured US$500 million international blue bond to Companhia de Saneamento Basico do Estado de Sao Paulo - SABESP (SABESP or the Company) and a proposed second tranche of up to an US$ 1 billion, out of which US$200 million are for IFCs own account (A Loan) and up to US$800 million are expected to be mobilized through a B1 Loans. IFC own account investment in the first tranche will finance the Companys water obsolete water meter replacement with smart water meters, while the remainder US$450 million will be directed towards the Companys blue capital expenditures program. As for the second tranche, proceeds will be used to continue supporting the financing of close to 4.4 million obsolete water meter replacement with smart water meters together with the construction of SABESPs new Integrated Operations Center.

The proposed project is expected to support the reduction of SABESP's water losses which should improvequality and resilience of water supply in Sao Paulo and Sao Jose dos Campos. It will also contribute to increasing resilience of water supply in Brazil by introducing and demonstrating the benefits of smart meters and digitalization to reduce water losses in regions facing water-related vulnerabilities.
